scope: Matched regional workloads, not identical coordinates: legacy forest versus new conifer, legacy rockland versus new canyon. Legacy locations are largest connected biome centroids from the frozen pre-change production survey; candidate locations were already frozen before visual/performance review. Original same-coordinate ocean-to-forest results remain reported separately. Same machine, resolution, settings, seed, duration and alternating three rounds; no dropped runs. Final candidate includes residency synchronization optimization. All final runs use actual 1280x720 backing (1x); earlier 2x and failed-size data are retained separately and never mixed into these medians.

forest.selection: Nearest largest connected regional component centroid on frozen 32 m production grid; no timing used

canyon.selection: Nearest largest connected regional component centroid on frozen 32 m production grid; no timing used
